## 2. Professional Biography
Fazal-e-Haq (widely known as Fazal) is an experienced Flutter Developer and UI/UX Designer dedicated to engineering responsive, high-performance cross-platform applications with silky smooth 60–120fps physics. His work combines rigorous software architecture (Clean Architecture, Feature-First modularity, GetX & Provider state management) with distinctive, tactile visual identities—most notably his signature Hand-Drawn Brutalism pencil sketch aesthetic.

As an active freelance engineer on Freelancer.com (https://www.freelancer.com/u/FazalehaqDev), Fazal collaborates with international clients, startups, and product owners to turn concepts into production-ready Android, iOS, and Web applications.

## 3. Freelance Capabilities & Services Offered
Fazal is available for hire for fixed-price projects, hourly contracts, and long-term development partnerships:
1. **Cross-Platform Mobile App Development (iOS & Android)**:
   - Full-lifecycle Flutter app creation from blank canvas to App Store and Google Play publication.
   - Clean architecture, reactive state management, background services, offline-first local databases (Isar DB, SQLite).
2. **Flutter Web & PWA Development**:
   - Single-page responsive web applications optimized for search engine crawlability (SEO), font tree-shaking, and WebAssembly (Wasm).
3. **UI/UX Design & Rapid Interactive Prototyping**:
   - Wireframing and high-fidelity clickable prototypes in Figma.
   - Hand-Drawn Brutalism and modern minimalist design systems with custom micro-interactions.
4. **Backend Integration & Cloud Infrastructure**:
   - Firebase (Authentication, Cloud Firestore, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, Firebase Hosting, Analytics).
   - RESTful API design, OAuth, JSON serialization, real-time WebSocket communication.
5. **App Performance Optimization & Code Auditing**:
   - Diagnosing render jank, eliminating frame drops, reducing bundle size, and ensuring 100% linter and test coverage.

## 4. Flagship Projects & Case Studies

### Project 1: CutCount — Barber Tracking & Revenue App
- **Role**: Sole Creator & Developer
- **Type**: Native Cross-Platform Mobile Application (Android, iOS)
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter, Dart, Isar DB, Provider, Custom Sketch UI
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/fazal-e-haq/CutCount.git
- **Description**: A private, 100% offline-first productivity and financial ledger application built for barbers and stylists to log haircut counts, calculate daily, weekly, and monthly earnings, manage service rate cards, and track tips without requiring internet connectivity.

### Project 2: CopyFlutter — Open-Source Flutter UI Component Library
- **Role**: Founder & Lead Architect
- **Type**: Web Application / Developer Platform
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter Web, Firebase, GetX, Dart, WebAssembly
- **Live URL**: https://copy-flutter.web.app
- **Description**: A curated library of production-ready, copy-paste Flutter UI components, animated buttons, interactive widgets, loaders, and templates designed to accelerate Flutter developer workflows.
